image_description: A close-up studio portrait of a small, fluffy puppy with white fur and reddish-brown patches, sitting on a textured maroon fabric background. The dog has large dark eyes, floppy ears with feathering, and a short muzzle. There is visible text watermark in the bottom left corner.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is domed with short upturned nose and well-defined stop.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head shape appears appropriately domed for a spaniel puppy, with a visible stop and short muzzle. The nose is black and distinct.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are large, round, dark, and set wide apart.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Eyes are prominent, dark, and round. Spacing appears correct for the breed standard.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ears are long, set low, and heavily feathered with long fringe.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Ears are visible, hanging low, and show significant feathering/fringe consistent with the breed.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rich red-and-white parti-color coat with clearly defined red patches on white ground.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coat pattern matches the Blenheim description: white base with distinct reddish-brown (chestnut) patches on the ears and body.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coat is long, silky, and straight with moderate feathering on ears, chest, legs, and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Texture appears soft and slightly wavy/silky. Feathering is evident on the ears and chest area.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is compact and cobby with short back of small toy-spaniel proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the body suggests a compact, sturdy build typical of a toy spaniel puppy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Legs are straight with fine bone and feathered hindquarters.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The front legs are mostly obscured by the chest fur and angle; hind legs are not visible due to the sitting pose and cropping.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is docked and carried level with back, well-feathered.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is completely out of frame or obscured by the body position.
The subject is stationary (sitting/lying down), so gait cannot be evaluated.

artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a watermark/text overlay that reads something like '© ...'. The characters are somewhat legible but have slight irregularities in stroke width and spacing typical of AI-generated or processed text, though it mimics a real copyright stamp.

Slight smudging or 'melting' where the white chest fur meets the darker background fabric. The edge definition is softer than expected for high-resolution photography, suggesting potential generation artifacts.
